ROUTES / SCHEDULE: FSE line structure confirmed (Line 5 Lecce-Gallipoli, Line 7 Maglie-Otranto, plus Lecce-Zollino-Maglie trunk). The FSE official site (fseonline.it / fssudest.it) is a JS-rendered Salesforce page and did not expose timetable HTML/PDF to the fetcher; Omio/aggregator pages were 403. Frequency was documented via aggregator: ~5 daily services each direction on the Lecce-Otranto corridor, journey Lecce->Otranto ~1h35-1h55 (change at Maglie), Lecce->Gallipoli ~1h. Because exact published clock times could not be scraped, stop_times use realistic even-headway clock times across the documented service window (approx 06:00-21:00) with inter-station running times scaled to the km posts from Wikipedia (Lecce km0, Zollino km19, Maglie km29, Otranto km47). Two representative routes built, each with both directions and 5 trips/direction.

CONFIDENCE 0.55: stops, ordering and coordinates are high-fidelity (Wikipedia/Wikidata/OSM); route existence and service span are documented; exact departure clock times are synthesized (even headway) rather than scraped from the official timetable, so times are approximate.
